correctionLog.independentCheck: Set A=(-a,0), B=(a,0), M=(0,0), l as the y-axis, and P=(0,t), t≠0. Then l⊥AB, the perpendicular foot from P to AB is M, and dist(P,AB)=PM=|t|. AM=a is not always equal to |t|, so only ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ are guaranteed; choice ④. The stem does not reveal the answer.

correctionLog.before: “A regular pentagon between two parallel lines” did not identify which vertices lay on the lines or the direction of its lower side; the requested angle could vary with placement/orientation.
